body:
Here’s another great example of what happens when people hear God’s call to be difference-makers in the world, using the skills and connections they’ve been given …

I had coffee last week with Dustin McBride and Michael Henderson – creative young guys involved with a project called “acirfa.” Their dream is to turn around lives in Africa “one bike at a time.” You can learn more at abikes .
